paper_title: BICEP / Keck XIV: Improved constraints on axion-like polarization oscillations in the cosmic microwave background
notes: Paper presents improved constraints on axion-photon coupling from CMB polarization oscillations using Keck Array 2012-2015 data. Main result: for oscillation periods 1-30 days (mass range 1.6×10^-21 to 4.8×10^-20 eV), median upper limit on rotation amplitude is 0.27°, constraining g_agamma < (4.5×10^-12 GeV^-1) × m/(10^-21 eV) assuming κ=1 (all DM is axion-like) and ρ_0=0.3 GeV/cm³. The coupling scales linearly with mass in the best-sensitivity region. Data points extracted from Eq. 16 and the stated mass range. The paper assumes local DM density of 0.3 GeV/cm³ for the coupling constraint. This is a CMB-based direct detection search sensitive to the local axion field, distinct from astrophysical or cosmological bounds. No new parameter space excluded compared to previous work, but improved sensitivity demonstrated. | selector: text (sole candidate)
